_comment: THE QUERY-PLAN ALLOWLIST (#1135, #1214). A registered read (`crates/domain`) that plans as a full scan or a temp B-tree outside the shape it declares fails `crates/domain/tests/reads.rs` unless it is listed here with its home (the read's name) and the one-line reason it is fine. Down-only: each `allowed` count may only fall, so the allowlist cannot grow in the change that needs it; an entry no read needs any more fails the test too. The fix for a hot read is the index it wants, in the baseline, never a row here.

_provenance.shape: EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN of every registered read over the founded schema, bound as the door binds it (the first-page sentinel for a keyset, the page size plus one for its limit)
_provenance.seededFrom: the new app plane (#1214): every read the old plane's allowlist excused was deleted with it, and no registered read needs a row
